returns._0: holdId 0 for the routine lane, else the new hold's id.

releaseHold(uint256).details: Only the VerdictContract (verifying TEE signatures off-chain) may call.

reportAttempt(address,uint96,bytes4).details: propose() reverts on violations, so its events never persist.      This non-reverting path is the on-chain record: anyone may relay      the attempt (observed from the reverted call), and the counter      + event survive. Unpermissioned by design — the attempt is a      public fact from the reverted transaction; spam only inflates      the counter, which pricing treats as a signal, not a fault.

decide(uint256,uint8).notice: The owner resolves a frozen hold (Approve / Freeze / Freeze+rotate).

freezeHold(uint256).notice: Watcher verdict: suspicious → freeze pending owner decision.

killSwitch().notice: Kill-switch: revoke the agent's spending authority entirely.

lapseHold(uint256).notice: Anyone may advance a lapsed pending hold: first extend 60 min,         then auto-freeze. Funds never move without verdict or owner.

propose(address,address,uint96).notice: The agent proposes a USDC transfer. Routine executes instantly;         elevated locks funds in a hold; violation reverts before broadcast.

releaseHold(uint256).notice: Watcher verdict on a pending hold: clean → release and execute.

reportAttempt(address,uint96,bytes4).notice: Persist the fact of a blocked VIOLATION-lane attempt (pricing         signal for the telematics engine; subgraph-indexed).

rotateAgentKey(address).notice: Rotate the agent key (freeze + rotate case).

setVerdictContract(address).notice: Wire the VerdictContract after deployment (watcher authority).

spendableUsdc().notice: Spendable balance: total minus funds locked in pending holds.

withdraw(address,address,uint96).notice: Owner withdrawal — custody is never locked. Bypasses policy.
